record.paper_title: 25 Open Questions About Vector Bundles and Their Moduli
record.context_brief: Hausdorff stratifying invariants on local Calabi-Yau threefolds
record.original_question: Let W_k denote one of the local Calabi-Yau threefolds O_{P^1}(-1)⊕O_{P^1}(-1), O_{P^1}(-2)⊕O_{P^1}(0), or O_{P^1}(-3)⊕O_{P^1}(1). Which local numerical invariants stratify the moduli of holomorphic vector bundles on W_k, for k ≥ 1, into Hausdorff components in the analytic topology?

evidence.quote: Question 20. What local invariants stratify the moduli of holomorphic vector bundles on Wk for k ≥ 1 into Hausdorff components (in the analytic topology)?

Contraction of a rational curve ℓ on a Calabi–Yau threefold W may occur in 3 cases [Ji], namely Nℓ/W must be isomorphic to one of (5.3) W1 := OP1 (−1) ⊕ OP1 (−1) , W2 := OP1 (−2) ⊕ OP1 (0) , or W3 := OP1 (−3) ⊕ OP1 (+1) . Let us denote by Wk any of the previous Calabi–Yau threefolds in (5.3).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{P}^1$ denote the complex projective line, and for an integer $k\ge 1$ consider one of the following rank-2 holomorphic vector bundles over $\mathbb{P}^1$:
$$W_1 := \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-1)\oplus \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-1),\qquad W_2 := \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-2)\oplus \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(0),\qquad W_3 := \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-3)\oplus \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(+1).$$
Each total space $W_k$ is a smooth non-compact Calabi–Yau threefold containing the zero section $\ell\cong \mathbb{P}^1$, and the three cases exhaust all possible normal bundles $N_{\ell/W}$ of a smooth rational curve $\ell$ that can be contracted on a Calabi–Yau threefold $W$.

Consider the moduli space $\mathcal{M}(W_k)$ of holomorphic vector bundles on $W_k$ (in the analytic topology). For a holomorphic vector bundle $E\to W_k$, one may attach local numerical invariants computed in a neighborhood of the zero section $\ell$ (for instance, the splitting type of $E|_{\ell^{(n)}}$ on infinitesimal neighborhoods, width invariants, or other holomorphic-analytic data localized near $\ell$).

Problem: Determine a complete set of local numerical invariants which stratifies $\mathcal{M}(W_k)$ into Hausdorff components in the analytic topology, for each $k\ge 1$ and for each of the three cases $W_1$, $W_2$, $W_3$.
artifact.category_tag: Moduli of vector bundles on Calabi-Yau threefolds
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a 2021 list of open questions about vector bundles and their moduli. Related work studies infinite-dimensional families of local Calabi–Yau threefolds and stratifications of moduli of vector bundles on them by width/splitting-type invariants, but no source found indicates a complete classification of local invariants giving Hausdorff stratifications for all $W_k$ with $k\ge 1$. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Infinite dimensional families of Calabi–Yau threefolds and moduli of vector bundles
status_evidence.snippet: Calabi–Yau threefolds that have infinitely many distinct deformations, describing the effect such deformations produce on moduli spaces of vector bundles.
status_evidence.claim: Related work studies moduli of vector bundles on local CY threefolds but the general stratification question is still being investigated.
